_comment: Examples under datrix/examples/ that the REAL generation pipeline cannot build today.
This is a DELIBERATELY MAINTAINED SCOPE BOUNDARY, not an auto-heal: it converts a genuine,
pre-existing generation FAILURE into a loudly-reported skip in the reference-example parity
gate (datrix/scripts/test/reference-example-parity-gate.ps1). It never hides output drift --
a listed (example, language) pair that does generate is still hash-compared against its baseline.
KEY FORMAT (language sweep): a bare example_id applies to every registered
language the gate sweeps -- for a failure at config-resolution/deployment-plan-building time,
before any language-specific codegen stage runs (the original two entries below). An
'example_id::language' key applies to that one language only -- for a defect in one language's
own codegen stage while the same example generates fine in every other registered language
(a distinction that could not exist before the language sweep made every example genuinely
All entries reproduce with the sanctioned generator (generate.ps1 <system.dtrx> <out> -L <language>),
so none is a gate artifact.
expected_count is a pinned, reviewed value: change it only in the same change that adds or
removes an entry. Removing an entry means the defect is FIXED and the example must be blessed.

examples.02-features-02-service-architecture-pubs: ConfigResolutionError ING001: the system declares a gateway {} block but no service derives ServiceIngressExposure.GATEWAY (a front door with nothing behind it). Example-definition defect: the example declares no external-caller auth(...) endpoint. Unregistered in test-projects.json, so generate.ps1 -All never built it. Follow-up: FIX-EXAMPLE-REPLAYABLE-INGESTION-ING001.
examples.02-features-03-infrastructure-blocks-con: ValueError from build_runtime_bootstrap: RuntimeBootstrap LOCAL requires config_store engine 'file' (platform 'container'), but the example declares engine='consul' platform='container'. The example's declared config store is incompatible with the LOCAL runtime-bootstrap contract. Unregistered in test-projects.json, so generate.ps1 -All never built it. Follow-up: FIX-EXAMPLE-CONFIG-STORE-CONSUL-BOOTSTRAP.
examples.03-domains-ecommerce::dotnet: Re-verified 2026-08-01: dotnet build fails across all 4 services with a wide mix of distinct defects. ecommerce_payment_service: JsonNode has no .Message/.Amount-style member (CS1061, 2 sites); a 'refund' local shadows an enclosing-scope 'refund' (CS0136); JsonNode<->string without conversion (CS0266, 2 sites). ecommerce_product_service: JsonNode cannot be constructed from a collection expression (CS9174, 2 sites); '??' applied to long and int (CS0019); a ReservationResponse constructor call omits its required 'Error' argument (CS7036); '+'/.Save() misapplied to JsonNode (CS0019/CS1061); a Product argument passed where JsonObject is required (CS1503); a Product.Publish(...) call omits its required 'db' argument (CS7036, the entity action-method call-site missing-DbContext-argument class also seen in city-services/food-delivery/etc.). ecommerce_shipping_service: JsonNode<->string (CS0266); a non-IActionResult value returned from an action expecting one (CS0126); ShipmentStatus enum<->JsonNode (CS0029); TimeSpan?.Days does not exist, needs .Value.Days (CS1061); a collection expression with no inferrable target type (CS9176). ecommerce_user_service: a User entity passed where UserResponse? is required (CS1503).
examples.03-domains-finance::dotnet: Re-verified 2026-08-01 after fixing the oldValue()/isChanged() camelCase field-resolution bug this entry used to describe (oldValue(kycStatus) failed to resolve against the entity's own camelCase 'kycStatus' field because the lookup only tried a literal snake_case or PascalCase spelling guess, never the field's OWN declared case -- FIXED in call_targets.py._lifecycle_field_cast_type by matching every declared field's own to_pascal_case() form instead of guessing a spelling; the DSL source here writes oldValue(kycStatus), camelCase, not snake_case as this entry previously claimed). Generation now proceeds past that error to real dotnet build failures: finance_account_service + finance_transaction_service: 7 calls to entity action methods (Account.Activate/.Unfreeze/.Freeze/.Close, Transaction.Complete/.Fail) omit their required 'db' and/or 'reason' arguments (CS7036, an entity action-method call-site missing-argument defect also seen in city-services/food-delivery/hr-platform/iot-platform/etc.); Currency is ambiguous between a cross-service client type and the local enum (CS0104). finance_compliance_service: List<ComplianceAlert> has no .Length (needs .Count, CS1061, 6 sites -- a query-result list, not an entity hasMany-relationship collection, so a DIFFERENT call site than the already-fixed relationship-collection case); JsonNode used directly in '>=' and '+' arithmetic (CS0019, 2 sites).
examples.03-domains-food-delivery::dotnet: Re-verified 2026-08-01: dotnet build fails across all 4 services with a wide mix of distinct defects, none from the JsonNode<->List<T>/decimal-literal class already fixed. fooddelivery_delivery_service: a Clients.DeliveryAddress value assigned where the local Schemas.DeliveryAddress is required (CS0029, 2 sites); a collection expression with no inferrable target type (CS9176, 2 sites); 5 entity action-method calls (DeliveryDriver.CompleteDelivery/.GoOffline/.GoOnline, Delivery.MarkPickedUp/.MarkDelivered) omit their required 'db' argument (CS7036, the entity action-method call-site missing-DbContext-argument class also seen in city-services/ecommerce/finance/etc.). fooddelivery_menu_service: ItemAvailability enum<->JsonNode (CS0029). fooddelivery_order_service: a collection expression with no inferrable target type (CS9176); PaymentStatus.Charged (a static enum member) accessed via an instance reference (CS0176); decimal has no .Value accessor (CS1061); a MenuItem value assigned where JsonNode is required, and JsonNode has no .Multiply method (CS0029/CS1061); OrderStatus enum<->JsonNode (CS0029). fooddelivery_restaurant_service: Restaurant.UpdateRating(...) omits its required 'db' argument (CS7036, same call-site class).
examples.03-domains-healthcare::dotnet: Re-verified 2026-08-01: dotnet build fails across all 3 services. healthcare_appointment_service: the SAME enum-to-string dispatch-argument-coercion gap as blog-cms::dotnet -- AppointmentType/AppointmentStatus enum values passed where a lifecycle-hook dispatch's declared String parameters are expected (CS1503, 4 sites); a collection expression with no inferrable target type (CS9176, 3 sites); Appointment.Cancel(...) omits its required 'reason' argument (CS7036, the entity action-method call-site missing-argument class); a 'long' assigned where 'int' is required with no cast (CS0266); JsonNode<->bool (CS0266); int has no .Value accessor (CS1061). healthcare_medical_record_service: JsonNode<->bool (CS0266, 2 sites); RecordType/RecordStatus enum<->JsonNode (CS0029, 2 sites); Prescription.Discontinue(...)/.Refill(...) omit required 'reason'/'db' arguments (CS7036, same call-site class); the identifier 'Store' does not exist in context (CS0103, 2 sites); byte[] has no .ContentType/.Size members (CS1061, 2 sites). healthcare_patient_service: a 'string' expression is awaited with GetAwaiter() -- same missing-await/wrong-return-type shape as city-services::dotnet's BeforeCreate hook (CS1061); PatientStatus enum<->string in a hook dispatch (CS1503, 2 sites) and enum<->JsonNode (CS0029, 3 sites); a 'patient' local shadows an enclosing-scope 'patient' (CS0136).
examples.03-domains-iot-platform::dotnet: Re-verified 2026-08-01 after fixing the oldValue() camelCase field-resolution bug this entry used to describe (same fix as finance::dotnet -- oldValue(firmwareVersion)/oldValue(status) now resolve correctly against the entity's own camelCase-declared fields). Generation now proceeds past that error to real dotnet build failures: iot_device_service: TimeSpan?.TotalSeconds does not exist, needs .Value.TotalSeconds (CS1061); Device.Decommission/.Activate omit 'db', .Heartbeat omits 'version' (CS7036, an entity action-method call-site missing-argument defect also seen in finance/food-delivery/hr-platform/etc., 3 sites); DeviceStatus enum<->JsonNode (CS0029, 2 sites). iot_firmware_service: 7 entity action-method calls (RolloutLog.MarkCompleted/.MarkFailed, FirmwareRollout.RecordSuccess/.RecordFailure/.Fail/.Complete) omit 'db' or 'error' (CS7036, same class); a double assigned where decimal is required with no cast (CS0266); a collection expression with no inferrable target type (CS9176); DeviceType is ambiguous between a cross-service client type and the local enum (CS0104). iot_telemetry_service: the namespace 'TelemetryService.Models.Docdb' does not exist -- a NoSQL/document-db model namespace the controller imports was never generated for this engine (CS0234).
examples.03-domains-learning-management::dotnet: Re-verified 2026-08-01: dotnet build fails across all 3 services. lms_course_service: a double? assigned where decimal is required (CS0266); a double assigned where int is required, 2 sites (CS0266); '??' applied to JsonNode and a collection expression (CS0019); Course.Archive/.Publish omit required 'db' argument (CS7036, the entity action-method call-site missing-argument class). lms_enrollment_service: JsonNode<->bool (CS0266); Enrollment.RecalculateAverageScore omits 'db' (CS7036, same class); Enrollment has no .Save() method (CS1061); a double assigned where int is required, 2 sites (CS0266). lms_student_service: a double assigned where decimal is required (CS0266); a double assigned where int is required (CS0266).
examples.03-domains-logistics::dotnet: Re-verified 2026-08-01: dotnet build fails across all 3 services. logistics_fleet_service (test project only): Vehicle.AssignDriver omits 'driverId', .ReleaseDriver omits 'db' (CS7036, the entity action-method call-site missing-argument class); a double assigned where decimal is required (CS0266). logistics_route_service: 'Route' is ambiguous between the generated entity (Models.RouteDb.Route) and Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing.Route (CS0104, 2 sites -- both AfterCreate and AfterUpdate hooks). logistics_shipment_service: a collection expression with no inferrable target type (CS9176); ShipmentStatus enum<->JsonNode (CS0029).
examples.03-domains-task-management::dotnet: Re-verified 2026-08-01: the previously-recorded 'too many values to unpack' Python arity bug no longer reproduces (same confirmation as real-estate::dotnet). Generation now proceeds to real dotnet build failures, none from the arity bug: taskapp_project_service + taskapp_user_service: a double assigned where int is required (CS0266, 3 sites total). taskapp_task_service: the DSL declares an entity named 'Task' and an enum named 'TaskStatus', both of which collide with .NET's own System.Threading.Tasks.Task/TaskStatus BCL types across nearly every generated file that references them unqualified (CS0104, 10+ sites) -- datrix-codegen-dotnet does not disambiguate a DSL type name that collides with a common BCL type in this namespace.
